# Shear Designs Hair & Beauty Co.

> Upscale private beauty salon in Richmond, Virginia, "servicing pixies and brows at Master level." Trendy short hairstyling (short hair only), semi-permanent ombré brows under the sub-brand BeautyFULL Brows PMU Artistry, and private one-on-one brow training. Owner: Shawntae Dupree Woolfolk, licensed cosmetologist.

Formerly known as: Shear Designs Hair & Beauty Lounge. Instagram name: "Pixie Expert". Client community: "Pixie Nation".

## Contact and location
- Address: 9501 Amberdale Dr, Richmond, VA 23236 (located beside Sheetz, under the BIG clock)
- Phone and text: (804) 965-3210
- Email: shadupree@yahoo.com
- Parking: free lot parking
- Setting: private, appointment-based salon; no guests allowed inside
- Website: https://sheardesignsrva.com/

## Booking and payment
- Book online on Square: https://square.site/book/EBT7A2A8BXAZJ/shear-designs-hair-beautylounge-beautyfull-brows-pmu-artistry-richmond-va
- After requesting, clients receive a text with consultation questions and must reply within 24 hours.
- New guests must book the New Client Package (Virgin Relaxer / Retouch / Cut / Style, $205) first.
- Deposits: Cash App $HairandbrowsRVA, or Zelle / Apple Pay to 804-965-3210.
- 10-minute grace period if the client notifies the salon; otherwise the appointment is cancelled as a no-show.
- Clients should stay home if sick.

## Hair menu (short hair only)
- New Client Package - Virgin Relaxer / Retouch / Cut / Style: $205 (1 hr 40 min). Required for new guests. Camouflage cut for thinning hair +$40 possible. Not available to clients with permanent color.
- Relaxer Retouch / Style: $125 (1 hr 25 min)
- Relaxer Retouch / Cut / Style: $150 / $175 (1 hr 45 min / 2 hr)
- Virgin Relaxer / Cut / Style (established clients, 3+ months since last retouch): $195 (1 hr 40 min)
- Relaxer / Zonal Mold & Style (sides & back): $145 with cut, $115 without
- Pixie Cut / Curl & Style: $95 / $120
- Cut - Shampoo & Mold (no curl): $75
- Shampoo / Wave Set & Curl: $85 (relaxer within 2 weeks, hair 3 inches or less)
- Shampoo / Soft Finger Waves (full head): $80
- Shampoo / Curl (includes steam): $55 / $75
- Shampoo / Mold Flat: $60
- Cut / Edge Up / Nape add-on: $5

## BeautyFULL Brows PMU Artistry (brows)
- Ombré Brows (Microshading) - most popular: $395 (2 hr 25 min). Lasts up to 3 years. $50 deposit.
- Touch-ups: 6-8 weeks $125; 8-10 weeks $145; 9-12 weeks (lapsed) $160; 12-16 weeks $175; 16-20 weeks $195
- Annual touch-up / color boost $250; 2-year $320; 3-year $360
- Ombré Brow Cover-Up / Correction: $500 ($50 deposit). Required when brows were previously done by another artist.
- Henna Brow Tint / Shape Up: $60
- Beauty Mark tattoo: $30 (lasts up to 1 year)
- Patch test: $10
- Preparation: no caffeine, alcohol or pain medication for 24 hours before.
- Not offered to pregnant or nursing clients, or clients with serious skin conditions or severe acne.
- Spa chair weight limit: 330 lbs.
- Healing stages: Day 1 new brows; Day 2 they look too dark; Days 5-10 scabbing and itchy; 2-3 weeks they seem to disappear; 3-5 weeks color returns; after the touch-up they are perfect.

## Academy (private one-on-one training)
- Microshading (Ombré) or Microblading: 1-day $1,095 (9:30 am - 4:30 pm) or 2-day $1,695 (day 2 on a live model, 10 am - 2 pm). Includes starter kit, tattoo machine, hands-on practice, 3 shading techniques, bloodborne pathogens certification, safety procedures, insurance information, marketing and branding strategies, certification, lunch and continuing mentorship.
- Deposit: $200 non-refundable (Cash App, Zelle or Apple Pay); balance due at the start of class in cash or Zelle.
- Refresher Course: $695 (4 hours), intro course within 24 months; prior students $50 off.
- Eyebrow Mapping: $375 (3 hours, kit included, $75 deposit); live model +$50 / +1 hour.
- Henna Brow Tint: $295 (2 hr 30 min) or $345 with model.
- Brow Model Day: $300 (3 hr 30 min), for previous students.

## FAQs
- Do they do long hair? No. Short hair only.
- Walk-ins? It is a private salon; request appointments on Square.
- Where to park? Free lot parking at the salon.
- Can guests come along? No guests are allowed inside the salon.
- How long do ombré brows last? Up to 3 years.
